mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM cps_invitation_mutex WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_wechat_user WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(invitation_code) = #{length} AND invitation_code REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' FOR SHARE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_wechat_user WHERE invitation_code = #{code} FOR SHARE
SELECT id, user_id, openid, invitation_code, inviter_user_id FROM sys_wechat_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR SHARE
SELECT id, user_id, openid, invitation_code, inviter_user_id FROM sys_wechat_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT w.id, w.user_id, w.openid, w.invitation_code, w.inviter_user_id FROM sys_wechat_user w INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.invitation_code = #{code} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' FOR SHARE
